idea-plugin.name: Reading Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Add notes to code lines and organize them by learning topic and group.

Click a gutter bookmark to view or edit notes without modifying source code. Search notes, navigate to code, resize the editor dialog, and switch the tool window between stacked and side-by-side layouts.

Notes are stored locally in your project's .idea/reading-notes.xml. The plugin does not send notes or telemetry to external services. The interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.

代码行笔记，按学习主题 → 分组 → 笔记组织。点击行号旁的图标查看或编辑；支持搜索、代码跳转、可调整大小的编辑窗口、上下或左右分区，以及随代码编辑移动的行锚点。

Open source under the MIT License. Source and issue tracker: GitHub.
